name: Contact Map
description: Adds a draggable floating contact widget (Google map, address, click-to-call phone) to every page.
project_description:
This module places a Contact map and address with a phone number (click-to-open) to the user.

User can drag and place the object in your website of the screen.

This module is very useful for a lead generation website contact for a user connection, it's available on your all web page it will allow them easily to contact.

 Conclusion:

When the user clicks the on the map circle(object) it will show the map and contact information.

 For getting Google API Key And More Information : 

 https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/embed/get-api-key 

 Contact Map Backend Setting : 

/admin/config/user-interface/contact-map
